_comment: v1 is the user-generated mascot tier: 9 art rows, no look grid. Stock Kettles mascots ship v2 (8x11, 16 look cells) and are authored in-house. The 14 state NAMES in stateMap are the contract shared by both tiers — see Docs/pet-design-system.md.

rows.intent: Calm breathing or blinking while no timer is active.
Active focus loop for hover or busy mode.
Playful carried or moved state while the desktop pet is dragged.
Short friendly acknowledgement on hover or click.

avoid: magnifying glasses unless already part of mascot

rows.intent: In-progress task loop, busy but not traveling across the screen.

stateMap._comment: Every name in PetAnimationState (src/lib/pet.ts) mapped onto the 9 v1 art rows. All 14 must resolve or the state silently falls back to idle at runtime. Aliasing is expected: v1 has fewer art rows than names.

aliasNotes.drag_left/drag_right: Both map to row 2. v1 carries no mirrored drag art, so dragging is directionless. Acceptable; v2 splits them across rows 1 and 2.
aliasNotes.running_left/running_right: Reserved vocabulary. Nothing requests them today; mapped to row 2 so they resolve rather than fall back to idle.
aliasNotes.reading: Alias of review. Reserved so a future mascot can split them without a host change.
aliasNotes.sitting: First idle frame, held. Do not derive it from the failed row — no row prompt guarantees the mascot ends that animation seated.
